changes.before: "I love the English. I am the child of Queen Victoria. But I am also King in my own country and must be treated as such. Somsteu [Theophilus Shepstone] must speak gently to me. I shall not bear his dictation: I shall perish first."

changes.before: "The poor French… They have not read their Mahan!"

changes.before: "It seems to me a defect in our much famed Constitution, to have to part with an admirable Govt like Ld Salisbury's for no question of any importance…, merely on account of the number of votes."
changes.after: "It seems to me a defect in our much famed Constitution, to have to part with an admirable Govt like Ld Salisbury's for no question of any importance..., merely on account of the number of votes."

changes.before: "Poor Mexico, so far from God, so close to the United States."

changes.before: "The policy and practice of the Russian Government has always been to push forward its encroachments as fast and as far as the apathy or want of firmness of other Governments would allow it to go…"
changes.after: "The policy and practice of the Russian Government has always been to push forward its encroachments as fast and as far as the apathy or want of firmness of other Governments would allow it to go..."

changes.before: "For a foreign power to take this country [the Sudan] would be most easy. The mass are far from fanatical… It is the government that needs civilizing far more than the people."
changes.after: "For a foreign power to take this country [the Sudan] would be most easy. The mass are far from fanatical…. It is the government that needs civilizing far more than the people."

changes.before: "The Sudan is a useless possession, ever was so, and ever will be so…"
changes.after: "The Sudan is a useless possession, ever was so, and ever will be so..."

changes.before: "You can scarcely imagine the beauty and magnificence of the palaces we burnt. It made one’s heart sore just to burn them; those palaces were so large, and we were so pressed for time, that we could not plunder them carefully."
changes.after: "You can scarcely imagine the beauty and magnificence of the palaces we burnt. It made one’s heart sore just to burn them;  those palaces were so large, and we were so pressed for time, that we could not plunder them carefully."

changes.before: "I have arrived at this place from Zanzibar with 115 souls, men, women & children. We are now in a state of imminent starvation. We can purchase nothing from the natives for they laugh at our kinds of cloth…"
changes.after: "I have arrived at this place from Zanzibar with 115 souls, men, women & children. We are now in a state of imminent starvation. We can purchase nothing from the natives for they laugh at our kinds of cloth...."

changes.before: "Said England unto Pharaoh, ‘I must make a man of you, That will stand upon his feet and play the game; That will Maxim his oppressor as a Christian ought to do,’ And she sent old Pharaoh Sergeant Whatsisname."
changes.after: "Said England unto Pharaoh, "I must make a man of you, That will stand upon his feet and play the game; That will Maxim his oppressor as a Christian ought to do," And she sent old Pharaoh Sergeant Whatsisname."

changes.before: "You [recruits] have sworn loyalty to me. You have only one enemy and that is my enemy. It may come about that I order you to shoot down your own relatives, brothers or parents… you must follow my orders without a murmur."
changes.after: "You [recruits] have sworn loyalty to me. You have only one enemy and that is my enemy. It may come about that I order you to shoot down your own relatives, brothers or parents... you must follow my orders without a murmur."

changes.before: "No quarter will be given! Prisoners will not be taken! Whoever falls into your hands is forfeited. Just as a thousand years ago the Huns under their King Attila made a name for themselves…"
changes.after: "No quarter will be given! Prisoners will not be taken! Whoever falls into your hands is forfeited. Just as a thousand years ago the Huns under their King Attila made a name for themselves..."

changes.before: "We shall first confront [the Russians] with arguments… and then settle it on the battlefield."
changes.after: "We shall first confront [the Russians] with arguments...and then settle it on the battlefield."

changes.before: "If you [French] are afraid to come… Then give back the cities you have taken. I am a merciful commander, and I will let you miserable ants live. But if you delay, my army will take your city and kill you all, and not even a blade of grass will mark where you stood."

changes.before: "The German officer in command of the troops left at Langfang, was attacked by the Imperial forces belonging to General Tung-fuh-siang's [Gansu Braves] division. Their numbers were estimated at 7,000 and they were well armed with modern rifles which they used with effect, so that we suffered considerable casualties."
